hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve hook that replaces the Uniswap v4 AMM for an ETH/MiniBTC pool. Buys mint MiniBTC via a forward curve; sells burn MiniBTC and pay ETH from the hook's accumulated reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden. Requires a swapper address ABI-encoded in hookData; enforces a 1-block cooldown between a wallet's last buy and any sell.
